Her family had not been able to reach her since Russian bombs devastated the front-line settlement of Komyshuvakha on Nov. 2, and feared she might be buried under the rubble. items.title: Germany's Merz speaks to Trump about Russia's war against Ukraine
items.teaser: The German chancellor and US president agree that the war must end soon and that any peace deal must also be approved by NATO partners.

items.title: UAH 15M bail posted for senior National Police official Tsenov in Carthage case
items.teaser: Bail of UAH 15 million has been posted for Volodymyr Tsenov, First Deputy Head of the Strategic Investigations Department of the National Police.

items.title: Leipziger Drohnenangriff: BKA sucht Verdächtigen mit KI-Bild
items.teaser: Der Generalbundesanwalt und das Bundeskriminalamt (BKA) haben im Zusammenhang mit dem Drohnenangriff am Leipziger Flughafen Fahndungsbilder veröffentlicht.

items.title: Zelenskyy blames Kyiv city authorities for worst energy supply situation of all Ukrainian regions
items.teaser: Following a conference call on energy supplies in the regions, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that the situation is worst in Kyiv because the city authorities have failed to prepare for winter.

items.title: Mitgliedschaft in terroristischer Vereinigung: IS-Anhängerin in Berlin verurteilt
Ukraine's Kyivstar raises outlook as digital business surges despite ongoing war
items.teaser: Kyivstar now expects its revenue to grow by 15%–17% this year, up from its original forecast of 14%–16%. Its revenue reached $349 million in the third quarter, up 17.5% from a year earlier, according to its quarterly financial results.

items.title: Monaco assassination attempt on Ukrainian businessman: intelligence officer's premises searched – lawyer
items.teaser: Lawyer Masi Nayyem has reported that the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) is conducting searches at the premises of an employee of Defence Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU) on the morning of 6 November as part of an investigation into the attempted assassination of businessman Vadym Yermolaiev in Monaco. items.title: “Just get into range”: Ukrainian F-16 pilot set record with M61A1 Vulcan cannon
items.teaser: A Ukrainian F-16 pilot downed nine Russian drones in a single sortie.

items.title: Ukrainian multi-drone control system deployed on front line
items.teaser: The Ukrainian military is already using the Pasika system from Sine Engineering, which allows a single operator to control a group of five drones on the front line.

items.title: A report put words in his mouth, a Korean CEO says—he never told the magazine Ukraine dropped his AI
items.teaser: Newtype Industries contradicts a published account of Ukrainian officials allegedly shutting down its battlefield tests.

items.title: G7 to hold separate meeting on Ukraine with Ukrainian foreign minister in attendance
items.teaser: G7 foreign ministers will meet in Paris with Ukraine's Andrii Sybiha to discuss air defence, financial and energy support amid intensified Russian strikes.

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte zerstören russische Militärlager in besetzten Gebieten
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte haben am 5. November und in der Nacht zum 6. November zwei Munitionslager der russischen Armee in der Region Saporischschja sowie eine Kontrollstelle für Drohnen und ein Treibstofflager in der Region Donezk getroffen.

items.title: Ukraine's Defense Ministry, Brave1 scale up EW-resistant group drone control technology
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Ministry and the Brave1 defense innovation cluster are working to scale up a technology for controlling groups of unmanned aerial vehicles that allows drones to remain resistant to enemy electronic warfare (EW) systems.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 1, injure 21 across Ukraine over past day as emergency power cuts hit 7 regions
items.teaser: The situation remains most difficult in Kyiv, where power limitations remain in place due to significant damage to energy infrastructure, the Energy Ministry said.

items.title: Russia destroyed 800,000 sq m of Ukraine's warehouse space in third quarter, says National Bank
items.teaser: Between July and September 2026, Russian forces destroyed 800,000 sq m of warehouse space in Ukraine, the National Bank of Ukraine reports.

items.title: Russian intelligence services recruiting Ukrainian refugees for sabotage operations in Europe – intelligence
items.teaser: The recruitment of Ukrainians for hybrid operations in Europe is part of a systematic campaign aimed at convincing Europeans that supporting Ukraine is costing them too much.

items.title: Russian arms giant Rostec touts radar targeting for its Kalitka anti-drone gun. Russia showed the trick a month ago
items.teaser: Kalashnikov says the turret already guards Russian command posts and supply routes at the front.

items.title: Ukraine’s anti-corruption agencies team up with top volunteer whose fund bought 299,365 drones. $1.25 million from their previous deals goes to army
items.teaser: National Anti-Corruption Bureau and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor’s Office were created as a mandatory condition of Ukraine’s European integration and the fight against top-level corruption.

items.title: Russia’s defense minister congratulated a division on taking Mala Tokmachka. A year later, that division is still trying
items.teaser: A Ukrainian military analyst places the same Russian unit at the center of a slow push on the town of Orikhiv in Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

items.title: Russian regions have slashed payments to families of soldiers killed in Ukraine by up to 20 times – Bloomberg
items.teaser: Over 10 Russian regions have cut their own payments to families of soldiers killed in Ukraine - Bashkortostan by 20 times – amid budget shortfalls, Bloomberg says.

items.title: Monaco assassination attempt on Yermolaiev: Lawyer reports searches at military intelligence officer's home
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) is conducting searches at the premises of an officer of the Ukrainian Defense Ministry's Main Intelligence Directorate (HUR) as part of an investigation into an attempted assassination of businessman Vadym Yermolaiev in Monaco.

items.title: Ukrainian maker DevDroid’s Droid Box now sends ground robots that lose Starlink back to point A
items.teaser: Their speakers can also tell Russian soldiers to surrender, and strike models with new thermal cameras are already with troops.

items.title: Ukraine strikes 2 Russian ammunition depots, other military targets in occupied territories, General Staff says
items.teaser: The ammunition depots were located near the town of Melitopol and the settlement of Khliborobne in the Russian-occupied part of Zaporizhzhia Oblast, according to the statement.

items.title: Energieinfrastruktur in Region Kyrowohrad und massivem russischem Beschuss
items.teaser: In der Nacht und am Morgen des 6. November haben russische Truppen Energieanlagen in der Region Kyrowohrad angegriffen, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Andrij Rajkowytsch, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: US$330,000 bail posted for senior Ukrainian police official in Carthage case
items.teaser: Bail of UAH 15 million (about US$330,000) has been posted for Volodymyr Tsenov, First Deputy Head of the National Police's Strategic Investigations Department, who is implicated in the Carthage case and was remanded in custody by the High Anti-Corruption Court (HACC) yesterday.

items.title: Preparation for leaders' meeting, sectoral ceasefire: Ukraine outlines agenda for Abu Dhabi talks
items.teaser: The Office of the President of Ukraine has outlined the issues that may be discussed during trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Death toll from Russian strike on Komyshuvakha rises to 53 as search operation enters 5th day
items.teaser: The strike was the deadliest Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia Oblast since the start of the full-scale invasion.

items.title: Russians again strike energy facilities that took three days to repair
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked several energy facilities belonging to DTEK, the largest private energy company in Ukraine, in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast again on the morning of 6 November, damaging equipment and causing a fire.

items.title: Russian forces strike several energy facilities in Dnipropetrovsk region
items.teaser: Russian forces struck several energy facilities in the Dnipropetrovsk region on the morning of November 6. The facilities had previously been targeted in Russian attacks.

items.title: Ukraine will resume air medical evacuations, cutting travel time severalfold, PM says
items.teaser: Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has said State Emergency Service aircraft will resume air medical evacuations, cutting patient transport times from 15 hours to two or three.

items.title: Russischer Angriff auf Komyschuwacha: 53 Leichen geborgen
items.teaser: In Dorf Komyschuwacha im Gebiet Saporischschja dauern Such- und Rettungsarbeiten nach einem russischen Luftangriff vom 2. November an. Bislang wurden 53 Leichen aus den Trümmern geborgen.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian ammunition depots in Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk regions
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck two Russian ammunition depots in the Zaporizhzhia region on November 5 and overnight into November 6, as well as an enemy drone command post and a fuel and lubricant depot in the Donetsk region.

items.title: They turned a park into a mortar firing range: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence reveals how Russians are destroying Ukrainian nature reserves
items.teaser: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine says Russian forces have set up a mortar range in Pryazovia National Nature Park and destroyed bird nesting sites in Meotyda park.

items.title: Ukraine: Trump stellt "sehr großes" Abkommen mit Russland in Aussicht
items.teaser: Der US-Präsident hat in Washington einen Kreml-Berater empfangen. Donald Trumps anschließendes Statement dürfte für Unruhe in der Ukraine und Europa sorgen.

items.title: Bodies of 53 people recovered from rubble of underground school in Komyshuvakha
items.teaser: Search and rescue operations are continuing at the site of the November 2 airstrike in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. So far, rescuers have recovered the bodies of 53 people.

items.title: Finland defense minister calls for burden sharing on defense and Ukraine, for the sake of European unity
items.teaser: Finland's Defense Minister Antti Hakkanen said European countries should commit at least 0.25% of GDP in support of Ukraine, which Kyiv has identified as the right percentage to keep it financially afloat.

items.title: Tillschneider als "Nazi" bezeichnet? Staatsanwaltschaft stellt Ermittlungen ein
items.teaser: Ist AfD-Politiker Tillschneider am Rande des Gedenkens an den Anschlag von Halle als "Nazi" beleidigt worden? Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat ihre Ermittlungen dazu abgeschlossen.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 188 Gefechte an der Front in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, die intensivsten - bei Pokrowsk
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden haben entlang der Front 188 Zusammenstöße zwischen den ukrainischen und russischen Streitkräften stattgefunden, teilt der ukrainische Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy facilities in Kirovohrad region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked energy facilities in the Kirovohrad region overnight and early on November 6.

items.title: They got the labs running again after Izium was liberated: Russian strike kills five women who worked at disease control centre
items.teaser: Five women who worked at a branch of the Kharkiv Oblast Centre for Disease Control and Prevention were killed in a Russian guided aerial bomb attack on the city of Izium on 29 October. They had been among the first to return to work after Izium was liberated from Russian occupation.

items.title: A Russian refinery rated at more than 6 million tons a year burns again in Krasnodar Krai
items.teaser: Estimates of the plant’s capacity vary, but it is consistently listed among the largest in southern Russia.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit two Russian ammunition storage points in occupied parts of Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.teaser: Ukrainian units have struck two Russian ammunition storage points in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, as well as a UAV ground control station and a fuel depot in Donetsk Oblast.

items.title: Man killed in Russian morning attack on Rivne region, damage reported
items.teaser: A man was killed in a Russian attack on the Sarny district, Rivne region, on Friday morning.

items.title: Death toll from Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia Oblast school reaches 53
items.teaser: The death toll from the Russian attack on a school in the settlement of Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, on 2 November has risen to 53.

items.title: After the Commercial Mediation Regulations: Revisiting the Arb-Med Interface in China
items.teaser: On 1 May 2026, the Commercial Mediation Regulations (the “Regulations”), issued by the State Council of China, came into force as China’s first administrative regulation dedicated to commercial mediation. items.title: Two police officers injured in Russian jet-powered drone attack on Derhachi – photo
items.teaser: Two police officers were injured when Russian forces used a jet-powered drone to strike the city of Derhachi in Kharkiv Oblast on the evening of 5 November.

items.title: Nach mehreren Klinikaufenthalten : Seniorin stirbt elf Monate nach Anschlag am Bondi Beach
items.teaser: Ende des vergangenen Jahres verüben ein Vater und sein Sohn aus antisemitischen Motiven einen Anschlag am Bondi Beach in Sydney. Einer der Angreifer wird von der Polizei erschossen, der andere muss sich vor Gericht verantworten. Nun steigt die Zahl der Todesopfer auf 16.

items.title: Five people injured in Russian drone attacks in Kyiv region over past day
items.teaser: Five people were injured and a dormitory at an educational institution was damaged in Russian drone attacks in the Kyiv region over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Zelenskyy reveals amount of undelivered US aid
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Ukraine has not received US$16 billion in American aid envisaged by previous agreements.

items.title: Energieanlagen in Region Kyjiw bei nächtlichem russischem Angriff beschädigt, es gibt drei Verletzte
items.teaser: In der Hauptstadtregion werden Folgen des nächtlichen russischem Angriffs in drei Bezirken festgestellt, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Tymur Tkagtschenko, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: EU's Costa backs Meloni's criticism of peace talks 'disarray,' plans to fix it
items.teaser: "I take note of your request to discuss this matter further at the forthcoming informal European Council meeting in Dublin, and I will make time for this discussion," wrote European Council President Antonio Costa.

items.title: Ukraine still unable to obtain details from US on allocation of US$400m in military aid
items.teaser: Ukraine has yet to receive information from the US on how the Pentagon will spend US$400 million in military aid, despite repeated requests for clarification.

items.title: Donald Trump kündigt "großes Abkommen" mit Russland an
items.teaser: US-Präsident Trump kündigt nach einem Treffen mit einem russischen Unterhändler ein Abkommen zum Ukraine-Krieg an. Es könne ganz Europa betreffen. Details nennt er nicht.

items.title: Drones attack Afipsky Oil Refinery in Russia's Krasnodar Krai, fire breaks out – media
items.teaser: On the night of Friday, November 6, a group of drones attacked the Afipsky Oil Refinery in Krasnodar Krai, southern Russia.

items.title: Beyond “the Infirm”? Persons with Disabilities in the Updated ICRC Commentary on the Fourth Geneva Convention
items.teaser: Not until the adoption of the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD) in 2006 did any considered attention turn to what international human rights law means for persons with disabilities during armed conflict. items.title: Brand in russischer Ölraffinerie nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: In der Nacht auf Freitag, den 6. November, haben Drohnen die Afipskij-Ölraffinerie in der südrussischen Region Krasnodar attackiert, wie der Telegram-Kanal ASTRA berichtet.

items.title: „24“ wird 25: Jack Bauer prägt die TV-Landschaft bis heute
items.teaser: „Ich bin Federal Agent Jack Bauer. Das ist der längste Tag meines Lebens“: Von denen hatte „24“-Star Kiefer Sutherland noch so einige. Erstmals raunte er diesen Satz aber vor genau 25 Jahren.

items.title: General Duka threatened detectives with gun and damaged equipment as Alpha unit shielded him – anti-corruption bureau
items.teaser: NABU has reported that during a search, SSU General Serhii Duka threatened detectives with a gun and smashed equipment with a hammer, while Alpha unit fighters tried to evacuate him.

items.title: Russian night attack damages energy infrastructure in Kyiv region, three injured
items.teaser: The consequences of a Russian overnight attack were reported in three districts of the Kyiv region, with three people injured.

items.title: Akim, Price, Boxer, and Criminal: Ukraine’s latest wiretaps read like a mob movie, with real officials in the cast
items.teaser: A security service general, a senior police officer, and an alleged enforcer are among five suspects, and judges have already ordered two of them held while the general still waits for his ruling.

items.title: Luftwaffe: 196 russische Drohnen unschädlich gemacht
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Luftstreitkräfte haben ihren eigenen Angaben zufolge 196 Drohnen, mit denen Russland die Ukraine in der Nacht auf den 6. November angegriffen hat, abgewehrt.

items.title: ADF neutralizes 196 Russian drones used to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 196 drones used by Russian forces to attack the country beginning on the evening of November 5.

items.title: War update: 188 combat engagements on front line over past day
items.teaser: A total of 188 combat engagements took place between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian troops over the past 24 hours. Russian forces applied the greatest pressure in the Pokrovsk direction.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,601,830 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,440 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.
